import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data["entries"]

# Organize by directory
from collections import defaultdict
dirs = defaultdict(list)
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.rsplit("/", 1)
    folder = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
    dirs[folder].append({"name": e["name"], "size": e["size_bytes"], "is_dir": e["is_dir"]})

# Print organized tree
for folder in sorted(dirs.keys()):
    print(f"\n📁 {folder}/")
    for f in sorted(dirs[folder], key=lambda x: x["name"]):
        icon = "📂" if f["is_dir"] else "📄"
        size_kb = f"{f['size'] / 1024:.1f} KB" if f["size"] > 0 else "empty"
        print(f"  {icon} {f['name']}  ({size_kb})")

print(f"\n--- Total: {len(entries)} files ---")
